## C. Verdict

### C1. Missing / to install (COMMANDS ONLY — NOT RUN)
```bash
# WSL — audio device enumeration (for STT input routing)
sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y pulseaudio-utils

# WSL — a project venv on a sane Python (3.14 is too new for most ML wheels)
uv venv --python 3.12 .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
#   (if uv cannot fetch 3.12: sudo apt install -y python3.12 python3.12-venv)

# WSL — Raphael runtime deps
pip install fastapi uvicorn websockets[client] pydantic soundfile

# WSL — STT (faster-whisper / CTranslate2)
pip install faster-whisper

# WSL — GPU PyTorch (driver = CUDA 12.7 → cu126/cu127 wheels)
pip install torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu126

# WSL — TTS engine deps (choose one stack)
pip install kokoro TTS            # or: sudo apt install -y espeak-ng
sudo apt install -y portaudio19-dev   # only if using pyaudio-based mic capture

# WSL — build tools already present (gcc 15.2 / make 4.4.1) — nothing needed

# Ollama: already installed+running in WSL (0.30.6) — NO install needed.
# Windows-side ollama is intentionally absent.

# Windows — auto-start "Body" at logon (create, do not run during inspection)
schtasks /Create /TN "Raphael" /TR "powershell -NoProfile -File C:\path\to\raphael-body.ps1" /SC ONLOGON /RL LIMITED
#   or: paste a shortcut into  shell:startup  (folder exists: C:\\Users\\<win-user>\...\Startup)
```

### C2. RAM / VRAM headroom — how much can run together
| Budget | Size |
|---|---|
| WSL RAM cap | **7.6 GiB** total, **6.2 GiB** free, 2 GiB swap |
| GPU VRAM | **8.19 GiB** total, **~7.1 GiB** free |
| Windows free RAM | 4.51 GB (host is already tight) |
| WSL disk (apparent) | 869 GB free — **illusory: shares C:'s 482.8 GB** |

**Verdict: TIGHT but viable ONLY if everything stays on the GPU.**
- ✅ **Fits comfortably:** small text model (`qwen3:1.7b`, 1.4 GB) + 4B VLM (3.3 GB) + faster-whisper `small` (~1 GB RAM) + TTS (~0.5 GB) ≈ **~5–6 GB VRAM** → all GPU-resident, RAM untouched. This is the safe configuration.
- ⚠️ **8B VLM (6.1 GB) + any text model + STT + TTS** = >8 GB VRAM → **spill to the 7.6 GiB RAM**, which then collides with STT/TTS. Do NOT run 8B VLM concurrently with a local text model; use the **4B-instruct** VLM by default (matches AGENTS.md vision pin) and keep the 8B for single-image deep dives only.
- ❌ **NOT viable:** any model >7 GB, multiple 7B+ CPU-offloaded models, or local 14B+ text models — the WSL 7.6 GiB cap rules them out.
- If more headroom is ever wanted: adding `.wslconfig` with `memory=10GB` would help — **NOT done here (read-only)**.

### C3. Risk notes
1. **No `.wslconfig`** → WSL RAM hard-capped at 50 % (7.6 GiB); Windows has only 4.51 GB free, so raising it steals from the host. Biggest single constraint.
2. **No autostart for Raphael** — no Scheduled Task, Startup folder empty. The Body will not survive reboot until one is created.
3. **`wsl` NAT networking + VM idle timeout** — the WSL VM can shut down when idle; the running `ollama.service` (systemd, enabled) currently keeps it alive, but a cold boot/`wsl --shutdown` leaves Raphael down. Task-Scheduler / startup hook should run `wsl -d Ubuntu-26.04 -u <wsl-user> -- systemctl is-active ollama` as a wake.
4. **systemd `degraded`** — only `tpm-udev.*` failed (harmless in WSL). No impact expected.
5. **No CUDA toolkit (`nvcc`) / no torch installed** — GPU works for PyTorch wheels and Ollama today, but compiling CUDA extensions would need the toolkit.
6. **Python version skew:** WSL default = **3.14.4**, Windows = **3.10.11**. ML stacks (faster-whisper, fish-speech, torch) target ≤3.12 → use a pinned 3.12 venv; do not rely on system python3.
7. **Audio:** `pactl` missing in WSL; WSLg Pulse is up and Windows endpoints (incl. **fifine USB mic**) are OK — mic capture must be verified after installing `pulseaudio-utils`. Windows NVIDIA Broadcast / DisplayLink devices may create extra loopback endpoints to filter out.
8. **Laptop on "Turbo" plan with battery present** — sustained local inference will draw power/heat; plugging in recommended for model loads.
9. **Single shared drive (user-confirmed):** WSL and Windows BOTH draw from C:'s 482.8 GB free — the WSL ext4 VHD is a file on C:, not a separate disk. Model caches (`~/.ollama`, HF cache) grow the VHD, which grows C: usage. Total budget for OS + models + everything = 482.8 GB. Ample for this project (models ≈ tens of GB), but never treat WSL's 869 GB as spare capacity.
